description: Describe this MCP server from its bundled profile without contacting any target or making a network call: repository URL, the default component set, components grouped by tier (required/core/optional), and optional MCP add-ons. It takes no parameters, is always safe, and returns instantly. Use it first to resolve a component id for install_component/remove_component/update_component or to see available add-ons; use inspect_target for a machine's live state.
name: describe_workbench

components.description: Every component with id, tier and description.

id.description: Component identifier — pass this to install_component.

manual.description: True when the step cannot be fully automated.

optionalMcp.description: Optional MCP add-on ids available in the profile.

packageRoot.description: Filesystem path of the installed package.

repo.description: Web URL of the workbench repository.

repoGit.description: Git clone URL of the workbench repository.

title: Workbench server info
